summary: Foundation phase (backend + frontend) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass — /api, /api/v1/health, /api/v1/health/db, all 9 empty-list resource endpoints, and /api/v1/sources (registry of 8 adapters, all implemented=false). Frontend: Home loads with brand 'VGC Intelligence', hero, status card and 7 quick-access tiles. Bottom tabs (tab-home/meta/tournaments/menu) render with correct testIDs. Lang toggle switches ES↔EN (Inicio↔Home, Torneos↔Tournaments, Menú↔Menu) while brand stays 'VGC Intelligence'. Meta and Tournaments tabs show ComingSoon with badge/title/body/back-btn testIDs. Menu tab lists 5 rows with expected testIDs. Tapping a menu row navigates to a secondary Coming Soon screen and the back button returns to menu. Quick-access tiles navigate to their target screens. Only issue found: testID naming inconsistency on secondary screens (kebab-case in code vs snake_case expected in spec) for team-builder, damage-calculator, vgc-guide.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses testID="screen-team-builder" (kebab). Spec expects screen-team_builder → back btn should be screen-team_builder-back. Actual is screen-team-builder-back.

Uses testID="screen-damage-calculator". Spec expects screen-damage_calc (matching menu-row-damage_calc and quick-access-damage_calc). Back btn is screen-damage-calculator-back instead of screen-damage_calc-back.
Uses testID="screen-vgc-guide". Spec expects screen-vgc_guide → back btn screen-vgc_guide-back. Actual: screen-vgc-guide-back.

action_items: Rename secondary-screen testIDs to snake_case to match menu-row / quick-access keys and spec: screen-team-builder → screen-team_builder, screen-damage-calculator → screen-damage_calc, screen-vgc-guide → screen-vgc_guide (this auto-fixes their -back suffix testIDs too). teams and analyzer are already consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: SecondaryScreen derives back-button testID as `${testID}-back`, so aligning the parent testIDs auto-fixes back buttons.
Backend structure is clean: routers/v1 aggregates all resources, sources endpoint reads from REGISTRY correctly, no MongoDB _id leakage since collections are empty.
i18n dictionary keys are complete for both ES/EN; no missing keys observed.
seed_data_creation: None — foundation phase intentionally has empty collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://vgc-intelligence.preview.emergentagent.com. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_foundation.py. Frontend uses mobile viewport 390x844. All key testIDs verified live except the 3 kebab-case secondary screens noted above.
